title: Parliament completes al-Zaidi cabinet; Asaib leader named deputy PM
detail: On Oct 15 Iraq's parliament approved 11 remaining cabinet portfolios and three deputy prime ministers, including Nayef al-Shammari (defence) and Yasir al-Maliki (interior). Deputy PM Laith al-Khazali leads Iran-backed Asaib Ahl al-Haq, a US-designated terrorist organisation. The migration minister vote was postponed over party disagreement. Al-Zaidi cited inherited debt above 208 trillion dinars and pledged to disarm non-state armed groups.
